import type { LatticeHandoff } from "../../contracts/handoff";
import type { NormalizedSearchResult } from "../../discovery/contracts";
import { resolveSelectedStructure } from "../../discovery/structure-resolver";
import { investigateConfigit } from "../../infrastructure/configit-intelligence-client";
import { investigateSap } from "../../infrastructure/sap-intelligence-client";
import { investigateWindchill } from "../../infrastructure/windchill-intelligence-client";
import type { SourceOperationCommand, SourceOperationError } from "../contracts/source-operation";
import type { SourceOperationResult } from "../contracts/source-operation-result";
import type { SourceExecutionPort } from "../ports/source-execution-port";
import {
  rejectedEvidenceResult,
  wrapCurrentIntelligenceEvidence,
  wrapCurrentStructureEvidence,
} from "./current-evidence-adapter";

export interface CurrentHandoffProvider {
  getHandoff(command: SourceOperationCommand): Promise<LatticeHandoff | undefined>;
}

const currentSources = new Set(["sap", "teamcenter", "windchill", "configit", "codebeamer"]);

function toSearchResult(command: SourceOperationCommand): NormalizedSearchResult {
  const selection = command.selection;
  if (!currentSources.has(selection.source))
    throw new Error(`Unsupported current source: ${selection.source}`);
  const metadata = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(selection.metadata ?? {}).map(([key, value]) => [key, value]),
  );
  return {
    resultId: metadata.candidateId ?? metadata.canonicalId ?? `${selection.source}:${selection.nativeId}`,
    source: selection.source as NormalizedSearchResult["source"],
    nativeId: selection.nativeId,
    displayName: selection.displayName,
    entityType: metadata.entityType ?? "engineering-item",
    matchCategory: "source-native-reference",
    matchReason: "Selected source identity supplied by the Investigation Kernel.",
    capabilityHints: [],
    sourceMetadata: metadata,
    provenance: {
      providerMode: "capability",
      retrievedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      sourceRoute: "investigation-kernel/current-source-execution-adapter",
    },
    canStartInvestigation: true,
  };
}

function operationError(cause: unknown, aborted: boolean): SourceOperationError {
  const message = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Source operation failed.";
  if (aborted)
    return { code: "source-cancelled", message, retryable: false };
  if (/timeout|timed out|exceeded/i.test(message))
    return { code: "source-timeout", message, retryable: true };
  if (/unauthor|forbidden/i.test(message))
    return { code: "authorization-failed", message, retryable: false };
  if (/authentication|sign.?in|login/i.test(message))
    return { code: "authentication-failed", message, retryable: false };
  if (/not found|no .* source|no usable/i.test(message))
    return { code: "not-found", message, retryable: false };
  if (/invalid .*contract|malformed/i.test(message))
    return { code: "contract-invalid", message, retryable: false };
  return { code: "unknown", message, retryable: true };
}

export class CurrentSourceExecutionAdapter implements SourceExecutionPort {
  private readonly resolvedStructures = new Map<string, { value: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof resolveSelectedStructure>>; observedAt: string }>();

  constructor(private readonly handoffs: CurrentHandoffProvider) {}

  private structureKey(source: string, nativeId: string): string {
    return `${source}:${nativeId}`;
  }

  resolvedHandoff(investigationId: string, subjectLabel: string, selections: readonly { source: string; nativeId: string }[]): LatticeHandoff | undefined {
    const sources = selections.flatMap((selection) => {
      const cached = this.resolvedStructures.get(this.structureKey(selection.source, selection.nativeId));
      if (!cached) return [];
      return [{
        source: selection.source as LatticeHandoff["sources"][number]["source"],
        label: selection.source,
        root: cached.value.root,
        nativeId: selection.nativeId,
        jobId: cached.value.jobId,
        capturedAt: cached.observedAt,
        completeness: cached.value.state === "ready" ? "complete" as const : "partial" as const,
        intelligencePayload: cached.value.intelligencePayload,
      }];
    });
    if (!sources.length) return undefined;
    const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return {
      version: 2,
      handoffId: investigationId,
      createdAt,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.parse(createdAt) + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
      subjectLabel,
      sources,
    };
  }

  private cachedHandoff(command: SourceOperationCommand): LatticeHandoff | undefined {
    const cached = this.resolvedStructures.get(this.structureKey(command.selection.source, command.selection.nativeId));
    if (!cached) return undefined;
    return {
      version: 2,
      handoffId: String(command.identity.investigationId),
      createdAt: cached.observedAt,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.parse(cached.observedAt) + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
      subjectLabel: command.selection.displayName,
      sources: [{
        source: command.selection.source as LatticeHandoff["sources"][number]["source"],
        label: command.selection.source,
        root: cached.value.root,
        nativeId: command.selection.nativeId,
        jobId: cached.value.jobId,
        capturedAt: cached.observedAt,
        completeness: cached.value.state === "ready" ? "complete" : "partial",
        intelligencePayload: cached.value.intelligencePayload,
      }],
    };
  }

  async execute(command: SourceOperationCommand): Promise<SourceOperationResult> {
    const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    try {
      if (command.identity.operation === "resolve-structure") {
        const resolved = await resolveSelectedStructure(
          toSearchResult(command),
          command.signal,
        );
        const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        if (resolved.state === "ready" || resolved.state === "partial") {
          this.resolvedStructures.set(this.structureKey(command.selection.source, command.selection.nativeId), { value: resolved, observedAt: completedAt });
        }
        const evidence = wrapCurrentStructureEvidence(resolved, {
          identity: command.identity,
          observedAt: completedAt,
          warnings: resolved.warning ? [resolved.warning] : [],
        });
        const status = resolved.state === "ready"
          ? "succeeded"
          : resolved.state === "partial"
            ? "partial"
            : resolved.state;
        return {
          identity: command.identity,
          status,
          startedAt,
          completedAt,
          durationMs: Math.max(0, Date.parse(completedAt) - Date.parse(startedAt)),
          evidence,
          warnings: evidence.warnings,
          error: evidence.validation.status === "rejected"
            ? {
                code: resolved.state === "timed-out" ? "source-timeout" : resolved.state === "cancelled" ? "source-cancelled" : "unknown",
                message: resolved.warning ?? `Structure resolution ${resolved.state}.`,
                retryable: resolved.state === "timed-out" || resolved.state === "failed",
              }
            : undefined,
        };
      }

      if (command.selection.source === "codebeamer") {
        const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        return {
          identity: command.identity,
          status: "empty",
          startedAt,
          completedAt,
          durationMs: Math.max(0, Date.parse(completedAt) - Date.parse(startedAt)),
          warnings: ["Codebeamer requirement intelligence is supplied by the accepted resolve-structure evidence for this slice."],
        };
      }

      const handoff = await this.handoffs.getHandoff(command) ?? this.cachedHandoff(command);
      if (!handoff) {
        const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        return rejectedEvidenceResult(
          command.identity,
          startedAt,
          completedAt,
          "Current intelligence execution requires a source handoff.",
        );
      }
      const current = handoff.sources.some((item) => item.source === command.selection.source)
        ? { ...handoff, sources: handoff.sources.filter((item) => item.source === command.selection.source) }
        : handoff;
      const value = command.selection.source === "windchill"
        ? await investigateWindchill(current, command.signal)
        : command.selection.source === "sap"
          ? await investigateSap(current, command.signal)
          : command.selection.source === "configit"
            ? await investigateConfigit(current, command.signal)
            : undefined;
      const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      if (!value)
        return {
          identity: command.identity,
          status: "empty",
          startedAt,
          completedAt,
          durationMs: Math.max(0, Date.parse(completedAt) - Date.parse(startedAt)),
          warnings: [`No current intelligence client is registered for ${command.selection.source}.`],
        };
      const evidence = wrapCurrentIntelligenceEvidence(value, {
        identity: command.identity,
        observedAt: completedAt,
      });
      if (evidence.validation.status === "rejected")
        return rejectedEvidenceResult(
          command.identity,
          startedAt,
          completedAt,
          "Current intelligence response failed contract validation.",
        );
      const sourceState = value.sources.find((item) => item.source === command.selection.source)?.status;
      const status = sourceState === "partial" || sourceState === "capability-limited"
        ? "partial"
        : sourceState === "unavailable"
          ? "unavailable"
          : sourceState === "timed-out"
            ? "timed-out"
            : sourceState === "cancelled"
              ? "cancelled"
              : sourceState === "failed"
                ? "failed"
                : "succeeded";
      return {
        identity: command.identity,
        status,
        startedAt,
        completedAt,
        durationMs: Math.max(0, Date.parse(completedAt) - Date.parse(startedAt)),
        evidence,
        warnings: evidence.warnings,
      };
    } catch (cause) {
      const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      const error = operationError(cause, command.signal.aborted);
      return {
        identity: command.identity,
        status: error.code === "source-cancelled" ? "cancelled" : error.code === "source-timeout" ? "timed-out" : "failed",
        startedAt,
        completedAt,
        durationMs: Math.max(0, Date.parse(completedAt) - Date.parse(startedAt)),
        warnings: [],
        error,
      };
    }
  }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\application\canonical-publication-coordinator.ts =====
import type { EvidenceEnvelope } from "../contracts/evidence-envelope";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { CanonicalAssemblyPort } from "../ports/canonical-assembly-port";
import type { InvestigationClock } from "../ports/kernel-services";
import type { InvestigationAuthorityPort } from "../ports/investigation-authority-port";

export class CanonicalPublicationCoordinator<TCanonical = unknown> {
  constructor(
    private readonly kernel: InvestigationAuthorityPort,
    private readonly assembly: CanonicalAssemblyPort<TCanonical>,
    private readonly clock: InvestigationClock,
  ) {}

  async assembleAndPublish(
    snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot,
    evidence: readonly EvidenceEnvelope[],
  ): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot> {
    await this.kernel.dispatch({
      type: "request-assembly",
      investigationId: snapshot.identity.investigationId,
      occurredAt: this.clock.now(),
    });
    try {
      const current = await this.kernel.load(snapshot.identity.investigationId);
      if (!current) throw new Error("Investigation snapshot is unavailable for canonical assembly.");
      const canonical = await this.assembly.assemble(current, evidence);
      return await this.kernel.dispatch({
        type: "publish-canonical",
        investigationId: current.identity.investigationId,
        revision: current.identity.revision,
        canonical,
        occurredAt: this.clock.now(),
      });
    } catch (cause) {
      return await this.kernel.dispatch({
        type: "fail",
        investigationId: snapshot.identity.investigationId,
        code: "canonical-assembly-failed",
        message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Canonical assembly failed.",
        occurredAt: this.clock.now(),
      });
    }
  }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\application\completeness-policy.ts =====
import type { CompletenessAssessment } from "../contracts/completeness-assessment";
import type { SourceExecutionSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";

export function assessCompleteness(
  requestedSources: readonly string[],
  executions: Readonly<Record<string, SourceExecutionSnapshot>>,
): CompletenessAssessment {
  const bySource = new Map<string, SourceExecutionSnapshot[]>();
  for (const execution of Object.values(executions)) {
    const list = bySource.get(execution.identity.source) ?? [];
    list.push(execution);
    bySource.set(execution.identity.source, list);
  }

  const successfulSources: string[] = [];
  const partialSources: string[] = [];
  const failedSources: string[] = [];
  const pendingSources: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [];

  for (const source of requestedSources) {
    const states = bySource.get(source) ?? [];
    if (!states.length || states.some((item) => item.status === "requested" || item.status === "running")) {
      pendingSources.push(source);
      continue;
    }
    if (states.every((item) => item.status === "succeeded" || item.status === "empty")) {
      successfulSources.push(source);
      continue;
    }
    if (states.some((item) => item.status === "succeeded" || item.status === "partial")) {
      partialSources.push(source);
      limitations.push(`${source} returned partial evidence.`);
      continue;
    }
    failedSources.push(source);
    limitations.push(`${source} evidence is unavailable.`);
  }

  const overall: CompletenessAssessment["overall"] = pendingSources.length
    ? "pending"
    : successfulSources.length || partialSources.length
      ? failedSources.length || partialSources.length
        ? "partial"
        : "complete"
      : "failed";

  return {
    overall,
    requestedSources: [...requestedSources],
    successfulSources,
    partialSources,
    failedSources,
    pendingSources,
    limitations,
  };
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\application\investigation-command-handler.ts =====
import type { InvestigationCommand } from "../contracts/investigation-command";
import type { InvestigationEvent } from "../contracts/investigation-event";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { InvestigationIdProvider } from "../ports/kernel-services";
import { assessExecutionResult, executionKey } from "./stale-result-guard";

export class InvestigationCommandHandler {
  constructor(private readonly ids: InvestigationIdProvider) {}

  handle(
    command: InvestigationCommand,
    snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot | undefined,
    nextSequence: number,
  ): readonly InvestigationEvent[] {
    const metadata = () => ({
      eventId: this.ids.eventId(),
      sequence: nextSequence,
      occurredAt: command.occurredAt,
    });
    switch (command.type) {
      case "create":
        if (snapshot) throw new Error("Investigation already exists.");
        return [{
          ...metadata(),
          type: "investigation-created",
          identity: {
            investigationId: command.investigationId,
            revision: 1,
            executionEpoch: 1,
          },
          subjectLabel: command.subjectLabel,
          query: command.query,
          selections: command.selections,
        }];
      case "begin":
        return [{ ...metadata(), type: "investigation-begun", investigationId: command.investigationId }];
      case "source-requested":
        return [{ ...metadata(), type: "source-operation-requested", identity: command.identity }];
      case "source-started":
        return [{ ...metadata(), type: "source-operation-started", identity: command.identity }];
      case "source-completed": {
        if (!snapshot) throw new Error("Investigation does not exist.");
        const active = snapshot.executions[executionKey(command.result.identity)];
        const decision = assessExecutionResult(snapshot.identity, active, command.result.identity);
        return decision.accepted
          ? [{ ...metadata(), type: "source-operation-completed", result: command.result }]
          : [{
              ...metadata(),
              type: "stale-result-rejected",
              investigationId: snapshot.identity.investigationId,
              identity: command.result.identity,
              reason: decision.reason ?? "stale-result",
            }];
      }
      case "request-assembly":
        return [{ ...metadata(), type: "canonical-assembly-requested", investigationId: command.investigationId }];
      case "publish-canonical":
        return [{
          ...metadata(),
          type: "canonical-published",
          investigationId: command.investigationId,
          revision: command.revision,
          canonical: command.canonical,
        }];
      case "refresh":
        if (!snapshot) throw new Error("Investigation does not exist.");
        return [{
          ...metadata(),
          type: "investigation-refreshed",
          identity: {
            investigationId: snapshot.identity.investigationId,
            revision: snapshot.identity.revision + 1,
            executionEpoch: snapshot.identity.executionEpoch + 1,
          },
        }];
      case "cancel":
        return [{ ...metadata(), type: "investigation-cancelled", investigationId: command.investigationId }];
      case "fail":
        return [{
          ...metadata(),
          type: "investigation-failed",
          investigationId: command.investigationId,
          code: command.code,
          message: command.message,
        }];
    }
  }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\application\investigation-event-reducer.ts =====
import type { InvestigationEvent } from "../contracts/investigation-event";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot, SourceExecutionSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import { assessCompleteness } from "./completeness-policy";
import { assertTransition } from "./investigation-transition-policy";
import { executionKey } from "./stale-result-guard";

export function reduceInvestigationEvent(
  current: InvestigationSnapshot | undefined,
  event: InvestigationEvent,
): InvestigationSnapshot {
  if (event.type === "investigation-created") {
    if (current) throw new Error("Investigation already exists.");
    return {
      identity: event.identity,
      lifecycle: "draft",
      subjectLabel: event.subjectLabel,
      query: event.query,
      selections: [...event.selections],
      executions: {},
      acceptedEvidenceIds: [],
      completeness: assessCompleteness(event.selections.map((item) => item.source), {}),
      warnings: [],
      createdAt: event.occurredAt,
      updatedAt: event.occurredAt,
    };
  }
  if (!current) throw new Error("Investigation has not been created.");

  const transition = (lifecycle: InvestigationSnapshot["lifecycle"]): InvestigationSnapshot => {
    assertTransition(current.lifecycle, lifecycle);
    return { ...current, lifecycle, updatedAt: event.occurredAt };
  };

  switch (event.type) {
    case "investigation-begun":
      return transition("resolving");
    case "source-operation-requested": {
      const key = executionKey(event.identity);
      const entry: SourceExecutionSnapshot = {
        identity: event.identity,
        status: "requested",
        warnings: [],
      };
      const executions: Readonly<Record<string, SourceExecutionSnapshot>> = {
        ...current.executions,
        [key]: entry,
      };
      return {
        ...current,
        executions,
        completeness: assessCompleteness(current.selections.map((item) => item.source), executions),
        updatedAt: event.occurredAt,
      };
    }
    case "source-operation-started": {
      const key = executionKey(event.identity);
      const prior = current.executions[key];
      if (!prior) return current;
      const entry: SourceExecutionSnapshot = {
        ...prior,
        status: "running",
        startedAt: event.occurredAt,
      };
      const executions: Readonly<Record<string, SourceExecutionSnapshot>> = {
        ...current.executions,
        [key]: entry,
      };
      return {
        ...current,
        lifecycle: event.identity.operation === "resolve-structure" ? "resolving" : "gathering",
        executions,
        completeness: assessCompleteness(current.selections.map((item) => item.source), executions),
        updatedAt: event.occurredAt,
      };
    }
    case "source-operation-completed": {
      const key = executionKey(event.result.identity);
      const prior = current.executions[key];
      if (!prior) return current;
      const entry: SourceExecutionSnapshot = {
        identity: event.result.identity,
        status: event.result.status,
        startedAt: event.result.startedAt,
        completedAt: event.result.completedAt,
        warnings: event.result.warnings,
        errorCode: event.result.error?.code,
        errorMessage: event.result.error?.message,
      };
      const executions: Readonly<Record<string, SourceExecutionSnapshot>> = {
        ...current.executions,
        [key]: entry,
      };
      const evidenceId = event.result.evidence
        ? `${event.result.identity.executionId}:${event.result.identity.operation}`
        : undefined;
      const acceptedEvidenceIds =
        evidenceId && event.result.evidence?.validation.status === "accepted"
          ? [...new Set([...current.acceptedEvidenceIds, evidenceId])]
          : current.acceptedEvidenceIds;
      return {
        ...current,
        executions,
        acceptedEvidenceIds,
        completeness: assessCompleteness(current.selections.map((item) => item.source), executions),
        updatedAt: event.occurredAt,
      };
    }
    case "canonical-assembly-requested":
      return transition("assembling");
    case "canonical-published": { const completeness=assessCompleteness(current.selections.map(x=>x.source),current.executions); const lifecycle=completeness.overall==="complete"?"ready":completeness.overall==="failed"?"failed":"partial"; assertTransition(current.lifecycle,lifecycle); return {...current,lifecycle,canonical:{revision:event.revision,publishedAt:event.occurredAt,value:event.canonical},completeness,updatedAt:event.occurredAt}; }
    case "investigation-refreshed": { assertTransition(current.lifecycle,"refreshing"); return {...current,identity:event.identity,lifecycle:"refreshing",executions:{},acceptedEvidenceIds:[],completeness:assessCompleteness(current.selections.map(x=>x.source),{}),warnings:[],updatedAt:event.occurredAt}; }
    case "investigation-cancelled":
      return transition("cancelled");
    case "investigation-failed": { assertTransition(current.lifecycle,"failed"); return {...current,lifecycle:"failed",warnings:[...current.warnings,`${event.code}: ${event.message}`],updatedAt:event.occurredAt}; }
    case "stale-result-rejected":
      return {...current,warnings:[...current.warnings,`Rejected stale ${event.identity.source}/${event.identity.operation} result: ${event.reason}`],updatedAt:event.occurredAt};
  }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\application\investigation-kernel.ts =====
import type { InvestigationCommand } from "../contracts/investigation-command";
import type { InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { InvestigationEventStore } from "../ports/investigation-event-store";
import type { InvestigationRepository } from "../ports/investigation-repository";
import { reduceInvestigationEvent } from "./investigation-event-reducer";
import { InvestigationCommandHandler } from "./investigation-command-handler";

export type InvestigationSubscriber = (snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot) => void;

export class InvestigationKernel {
  private readonly subscribers = new Map<InvestigationId, Set<InvestigationSubscriber>>();
  private readonly queues = new Map<InvestigationId, Promise<void>>();

  constructor(
    private readonly repository: InvestigationRepository,
    private readonly events: InvestigationEventStore,
    private readonly commands: InvestigationCommandHandler,
  ) {}

  dispatch(command: InvestigationCommand): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot> {
    const id = this.commandInvestigationId(command);
    const prior = this.queues.get(id) ?? Promise.resolve();
    let release!: () => void;
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
    const queued = prior.then(() => gate);
    this.queues.set(id, queued);
    return prior
      .then(() => this.dispatchSerial(id, command))
      .finally(() => {
        release();
        if (this.queues.get(id) === queued) this.queues.delete(id);
      });
  }

  load(id: InvestigationId): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot | undefined> {
    return this.repository.load(id);
  }

  subscribe(id: InvestigationId, subscriber: InvestigationSubscriber): () => void {
    const set = this.subscribers.get(id) ?? new Set<InvestigationSubscriber>();
    set.add(subscriber);
    this.subscribers.set(id, set);
    return () => {
      set.delete(subscriber);
      if (!set.size) this.subscribers.delete(id);
    };
  }

  private async dispatchSerial(
    id: InvestigationId,
    command: InvestigationCommand,
  ): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot> {
    const [snapshot, stream] = await Promise.all([
      this.repository.load(id),
      this.events.read(id),
    ]);
    const produced = this.commands.handle(command, snapshot, stream.length);
    let next = snapshot;
    for (const event of produced) next = reduceInvestigationEvent(next, event);
    if (!next) throw new Error("Command did not produce an investigation snapshot.");
    await this.events.append(id, produced, stream.length);
    await this.repository.save(next, snapshot?.identity.revision ?? next.identity.revision);
    this.publish(next);
    return next;
  }

  private commandInvestigationId(command: InvestigationCommand): InvestigationId {
    return command.type === "source-requested" || command.type === "source-started"
      ? command.identity.investigationId
      : command.type === "source-completed"
        ? command.result.identity.investigationId
        : command.investigationId;
  }

  private publish(snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot): void {
    for (const subscriber of this.subscribers.get(snapshot.identity.investigationId) ?? [])
      subscriber(snapshot);
  }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\application\investigation-transition-policy.ts =====
import type { InvestigationLifecycle } from "../contracts/investigation-lifecycle";

const allowed: Readonly<Record<InvestigationLifecycle, readonly InvestigationLifecycle[]>> = {
  draft: ["resolving", "cancelled", "failed"],
  resolving: ["gathering", "assembling", "partial", "failed", "cancelled"],
  gathering: ["assembling", "partial", "failed", "cancelled"],
  assembling: ["ready", "partial", "failed", "cancelled"],
  ready: ["refreshing", "cancelled"],
  partial: ["refreshing", "cancelled"],
  failed: ["refreshing"],
  cancelled: ["refreshing"],
  refreshing: ["resolving", "gathering", "assembling", "partial", "failed", "cancelled"],
};

export const canTransition = (from: InvestigationLifecycle, to: InvestigationLifecycle): boolean =>
  from === to || allowed[from].includes(to);

export const assertTransition = (from: InvestigationLifecycle, to: InvestigationLifecycle): void => {
  if (!canTransition(from, to)) throw new Error(`Invalid investigation transition: ${from} -> ${to}`);
};


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\application\source-execution-coordinator.ts =====
import type { EvidenceEnvelope } from "../contracts/evidence-envelope";
import type { ExecutionIdentity, SourceOperationKind } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { SourceOperationCommand, SourceSelection } from "../contracts/source-operation";
import type { InvestigationIdProvider, InvestigationClock } from "../ports/kernel-services";
import type { SourceExecutionPort } from "../ports/source-execution-port";
import type { InvestigationAuthorityPort } from "../ports/investigation-authority-port";

export interface CoordinatedExecution {
  evidence: readonly EvidenceEnvelope[];
  snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot;
}

export class SourceExecutionCoordinator {
  private readonly controllers = new Map<string, AbortController>();

  constructor(
    private readonly kernel: InvestigationAuthorityPort,
    private readonly executor: SourceExecutionPort,
    private readonly ids: InvestigationIdProvider,
    private readonly clock: InvestigationClock,
  ) {}

  async run(snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot): Promise<CoordinatedExecution> {
    await this.kernel.dispatch({
      type: "begin",
      investigationId: snapshot.identity.investigationId,
      occurredAt: this.clock.now(),
    });
    const resolveSelection = (selection: SourceSelection) => this.runOperation(snapshot, selection, "resolve-structure");
    const codebeamer = snapshot.selections.filter((selection) => selection.source === "codebeamer");
    const others = snapshot.selections.filter((selection) => selection.source !== "codebeamer");
    const boundedCodebeamer = await this.runBounded(codebeamer, 3, resolveSelection);
    const structures = [...await Promise.all(others.map(resolveSelection)), ...boundedCodebeamer];
    const intelligence = await Promise.all(snapshot.selections.map((selection) =>
      this.runOperation(snapshot, selection, "gather-intelligence"),
    ));
    const latest = await this.kernel.load(snapshot.identity.investigationId);
    if (!latest) throw new Error("Investigation snapshot disappeared during execution.");
    return {
      evidence: [...structures, ...intelligence].flatMap((result) => result ? [result] : []),
      snapshot: latest,
    };
  }

  private async runBounded<T, R>(items: readonly T[], limit: number, worker: (item: T) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]> {
    const results = new Array<R>(items.length); let cursor = 0;
    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, items.length) }, async () => { while (cursor < items.length) { const index = cursor++; results[index] = await worker(items[index]); } }));
    return results;
  }

  cancel(snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot): void {
    for (const [key, controller] of this.controllers) {
      if (key.startsWith(`${snapshot.identity.investigationId}:`)) controller.abort("investigation-cancelled");
    }
  }

  private async runOperation(
    snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot,
    selection: SourceSelection,
    operation: SourceOperationKind,
  ): Promise<EvidenceEnvelope | undefined> {
    const identity: ExecutionIdentity = {
      ...snapshot.identity,
      executionId: this.ids.executionId(),
      correlationId: this.ids.correlationId(),
      source: selection.source,
      operation,
      attempt: 1,
    };
    const key = `${snapshot.identity.investigationId}:${identity.executionId}`;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    this.controllers.set(key, controller);
    const command: SourceOperationCommand = { identity, selection, signal: controller.signal };
    await this.kernel.dispatch({ type: "source-requested", identity, occurredAt: this.clock.now() });
    await this.kernel.dispatch({ type: "source-started", identity, occurredAt: this.clock.now() });
    try {
      const result = await this.executor.execute(command);
      await this.kernel.dispatch({ type: "source-completed", result, occurredAt: this.clock.now() });
      return result.evidence?.validation.status === "accepted" ? result.evidence : undefined;
    } finally {
      this.controllers.delete(key);
    }
  }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\application\stale-result-guard.ts =====
import type { ExecutionIdentity, InvestigationIdentity } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { SourceExecutionSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";

export interface StaleResultDecision {
  accepted: boolean;
  reason?: string;
}

export const executionKey = (identity: ExecutionIdentity): string =>
  [identity.source, identity.operation, identity.attempt].join(":");

export function assessExecutionResult(
  current: InvestigationIdentity,
  active: SourceExecutionSnapshot | undefined,
  incoming: ExecutionIdentity,
): StaleResultDecision {
  if (incoming.investigationId !== current.investigationId)
    return { accepted: false, reason: "investigation-id-mismatch" };
  if (incoming.revision !== current.revision)
    return { accepted: false, reason: "revision-mismatch" };
  if (incoming.executionEpoch !== current.executionEpoch)
    return { accepted: false, reason: "execution-epoch-mismatch" };
  if (!active) return { accepted: false, reason: "execution-not-active" };
  if (active.identity.executionId !== incoming.executionId)
    return { accepted: false, reason: "execution-id-mismatch" };
  if (active.identity.attempt !== incoming.attempt)
    return { accepted: false, reason: "attempt-mismatch" };
  if (active.identity.source !== incoming.source || active.identity.operation !== incoming.operation)
    return { accepted: false, reason: "operation-mismatch" };
  return { accepted: true };
}

import type { ExecutionIdentity } from "./investigation-identity";

export interface SourceOperationResult<TPayload = unknown> {
  identity: ExecutionIdentity;
  status: Exclude<SourceOperationStatus, "requested" | "running">;
  startedAt: string;

export function legacyEvidenceToCandidate<TPayload>(value: LegacyEvidenceEnvelope<TPayload>, receivedAt = new Date().toISOString()): EvidenceCandidate<TPayload> {

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\evidence\default-evidence-validator.ts =====
import type { EvidenceValidator } from "./evidence-validator";
import { issue } from "./evidence-validator";
import type { EvidenceCandidate, EvidenceIssue, EvidenceSchemaIdentity } from "./evidence-contracts";

export class BasicEvidenceValidator implements EvidenceValidator {
  readonly name = "lattice-basic-evidence-validator";
  constructor(readonly schema: EvidenceSchemaIdentity) {}
  validate(candidate: EvidenceCandidate): readonly EvidenceIssue[] {
    const issues: EvidenceIssue[] = [];
    if (!candidate.identity.investigationId) issues.push(issue("missing-investigation-id", "Investigation identity is required.", "identity.investigationId"));
    if (candidate.identity.revision < 1) issues.push(issue("invalid-investigation-revision", "Investigation revision must be positive.", "identity.revision"));
    if (!candidate.identity.executionId) issues.push(issue("missing-execution-id", "Execution identity is required.", "identity.executionId"));
    if (!candidate.identity.source.trim()) issues.push(issue("missing-source", "Evidence source is required.", "identity.source"));
    if (!candidate.provenance.provider.trim()) issues.push(issue("missing-provider", "Evidence provider is required.", "provenance.provider"));
    if (!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(candidate.capturedAt))) issues.push(issue("invalid-captured-at", "capturedAt must be an ISO timestamp.", "capturedAt"));
    if (!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(candidate.receivedAt))) issues.push(issue("invalid-received-at", "receivedAt must be an ISO timestamp.", "receivedAt"));
    if (candidate.payload === undefined) issues.push(issue("missing-payload", "Evidence payload cannot be undefined.", "payload"));
    if (["synthetic", "mocked", "hardcoded"].includes(candidate.authority))
      issues.push(issue("non-authoritative-evidence", `${candidate.authority} evidence is isolated from authoritative evidence.`, "authority", "warning"));
    if (candidate.authority === "unavailable" && candidate.completeness !== "unavailable")
      issues.push(issue("authority-completeness-conflict", "Unavailable evidence must declare unavailable completeness.", "completeness"));
    return issues;
  }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\evidence\evidence-acceptance-service.ts =====
import { hashEvidencePayload } from "./evidence-hasher";
import { asEvidenceId, type AcceptedEvidenceEnvelope, type EvidenceCandidate, type EvidenceDecision, type EvidenceIssue, type EvidenceValidationResult } from "./evidence-contracts";
import { EvidenceValidationRegistry, issue } from "./evidence-validator";

const evidenceIdFor = async (candidate: EvidenceCandidate, payloadHash: string) => {
  const identity = `${candidate.identity.investigationId}|${candidate.identity.revision}|${candidate.identity.executionId}|${candidate.identity.source}|${candidate.identity.operation}|${candidate.schema.name}|${candidate.schema.version}|${payloadHash}`;
  return asEvidenceId(`evidence:${(await hashEvidencePayload(identity)).replace("sha256:", "")}`);
};
const freeze = <T>(value: T): T => {
  if (value && typeof value === "object" && !Object.isFrozen(value)) {
    Object.freeze(value);
    for (const nested of Object.values(value as Record<string, unknown>)) freeze(nested);
  }
  return value;
};

export class EvidenceAcceptanceService {
  constructor(private readonly validators: EvidenceValidationRegistry, private readonly now: () => string = () => new Date().toISOString()) {}

  async evaluate<TPayload>(candidate: EvidenceCandidate<TPayload>): Promise<EvidenceDecision<TPayload>> {
    let payloadHash;
    const issues: EvidenceIssue[] = [];
    try { payloadHash = await hashEvidencePayload(candidate.payload); }
    catch (error) {
      payloadHash = await hashEvidencePayload({ hashingFailure: true });
      issues.push(issue("payload-not-canonicalizable", error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Evidence payload cannot be canonicalized.", "payload"));
    }
    const validator = this.validators.resolve(candidate.schema);
    if (!validator) issues.push(issue("validator-not-registered", `No validator is registered for ${candidate.schema.name}@${candidate.schema.version}.`, "schema"));
    else issues.push(...await validator.validate(candidate as EvidenceCandidate));
    const evidenceId = await evidenceIdFor(candidate, payloadHash);
    const validation: EvidenceValidationResult = {
      status: issues.some((item) => item.severity === "error") ? "rejected" : "accepted",
      schema: candidate.schema,
      validatedAt: this.now(),
      validator: validator?.name ?? "unregistered",
      issues,
    };
    const common = {
      evidenceId,
      investigationId: candidate.identity.investigationId,
      execution: candidate.identity,
      schema: candidate.schema,
      authority: candidate.authority,
      payloadHash,
      receivedAt: candidate.receivedAt,
      provenance: candidate.provenance,
      validation,
      warnings: [...candidate.warnings],
      payload: candidate.payload,
    };
    if (validation.status === "rejected") return freeze({ status: "rejected", ...common, validation: { ...validation, status: "rejected" as const } });
    const evidence: AcceptedEvidenceEnvelope<TPayload> = freeze({
      envelopeVersion: "2.0",
      ...common,
      investigationRevision: candidate.identity.revision,
      capturedAt: candidate.capturedAt,
      freshness: candidate.freshness,
      completeness: candidate.completeness,
      validation: { ...validation, status: "accepted" },
    });
    return { status: "accepted", evidence };
  }

  async verify(envelope: AcceptedEvidenceEnvelope): Promise<boolean> {
    return await hashEvidencePayload(envelope.payload) === envelope.payloadHash;
  }
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\evidence\evidence-hasher.ts =====
import { asEvidencePayloadHash, type EvidencePayloadHash } from "./evidence-contracts";
import { stableJson } from "./stable-json";

export async function hashEvidencePayload(payload: unknown): Promise<EvidencePayloadHash> {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(stableJson(payload));
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
  return asEvidencePayloadHash(`sha256:${[...new Uint8Array(digest)].map((value) => value.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("")}`);
}

import type { EvidenceCandidate, EvidenceIssue, EvidenceSchemaIdentity } from "./evidence-contracts";

export interface EvidenceValidator<TPayload = unknown> {

  readonly name: string;
  validate(candidate: EvidenceCandidate<TPayload>): readonly EvidenceIssue[] | Promise<readonly EvidenceIssue[]>;
}

export class EvidenceValidationRegistry {
  private readonly validators = new Map<string, EvidenceValidator>();
  register(validator: EvidenceValidator): void {
    const key = this.key(validator.schema);
    if (this.validators.has(key)) throw new Error(`Evidence validator already registered for ${key}.`);
    this.validators.set(key, validator);
  }
  resolve(schema: EvidenceSchemaIdentity): EvidenceValidator | undefined {
    return this.validators.get(this.key(schema));
  }
  private key(schema: EvidenceSchemaIdentity): string { return `${schema.name}@${schema.version}`; }
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\evidence\stable-json.ts =====
function normalized(value: unknown, seen: WeakSet<object>): unknown {
  if (value === null || typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "boolean") return value;
  if (typeof value === "number") return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : String(value);
  if (typeof value === "bigint") return value.toString();
  if (value instanceof Date) return value.toISOString();
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => normalized(item, seen));
  if (typeof value === "object") {
    if (seen.has(value)) throw new Error("Evidence payload contains a circular reference.");
    seen.add(value);
    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    const output = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(record).sort().flatMap((key) => {
        const current = record[key];
        return current === undefined || typeof current === "function" || typeof current === "symbol"
          ? []
          : [[key, normalized(current, seen)]];
      }),
    );
    seen.delete(value);
    return output;
  }
  return String(value);
}

export function stableJson(value: unknown): string {
  return JSON.stringify(normalized(value, new WeakSet<object>()));
}

"use client";

import type { InvestigationEvent } from "../contracts/investigation-event";
import type { InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationEventStore } from "../ports/investigation-event-store";

const PREFIX = "lattice-kernel:events:";

export class BrowserInvestigationEventStore implements InvestigationEventStore {
  async append(id: InvestigationId, events: readonly InvestigationEvent[], expectedSequence: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = await this.read(id);
    if (current.length !== expectedSequence) {
      throw new Error(`Event sequence conflict: expected ${expectedSequence}, found ${current.length}.`);
    }
    localStorage.setItem(`${PREFIX}${id}`, JSON.stringify([...current, ...events]));
  }

  async read(id: InvestigationId): Promise<readonly InvestigationEvent[]> {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}${id}`);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) as InvestigationEvent[] : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }
}

"use client";

import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";

const PREFIX = "lattice-kernel:snapshot:";

export class BrowserInvestigationRepository implements InvestigationRepository {
  async load<TCanonical = unknown>(id: InvestigationId): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> | undefined> {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}${id}`);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) as InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> : undefined;
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  async save<TCanonical = unknown>(snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical>, expectedRevision: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = await this.load(snapshot.identity.investigationId);
    if (current && current.identity.revision !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new Error(`Investigation revision conflict: expected ${expectedRevision}, found ${current.identity.revision}.`);
    }
    localStorage.setItem(`${PREFIX}${snapshot.identity.investigationId}`, JSON.stringify(snapshot));
  }
}

            candidateId: item.resultId,
            canonicalId: item.resultId,
            entityType: item.entityType,
          },
        })),
      );
      const investigationId = snapshot.identity.investigationId;
      const execution = await sourceCoordinator.run(snapshot);
      snapshot = await publication.assembleAndPublish(execution.snapshot, execution.evidence);
      const canonical = snapshot.canonical?.value;
      if (!isEngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1(canonical)) {
        throw new Error(snapshot.warnings.at(-1) ?? "Investigation Kernel did not publish a valid canonical result.");
      }
      const handoff = executor.resolvedHandoff(String(investigationId), subjectLabel, snapshot.selections);
      if (!handoff) throw new Error("Investigation Kernel resolved no source structures.");
      return { snapshot: snapshot as InvestigationSnapshot<EngineeringIntelligenceInvestigationV1>, canonical, handoff };
    },
  };
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\infrastructure\http-investigation-authority.ts =====
"use client";

import type { InvestigationCommand } from "../contracts/investigation-command";
import { asInvestigationId, type InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { SourceSelection } from "../contracts/source-operation";
import type { InvestigationAuthorityPort } from "../ports/investigation-authority-port";

export class InvestigationAuthorityError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly status: number, message: string) { super(message); }
}

async function read<T>(response: Response): Promise<T> {
  const value = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!response.ok) throw new InvestigationAuthorityError(response.status, value?.message ?? "Investigation authority request failed.");
  return value as T;
}

export class HttpInvestigationAuthority implements InvestigationAuthorityPort {
  constructor(private readonly baseUrl = "/api/lattice/investigations") {}

  async create(subjectLabel: string, query: string, selections: readonly SourceSelection[]): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot> {
    const response = await fetch(this.baseUrl, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ subjectLabel, query, selections }),
      cache: "no-store",
    });
    return read<InvestigationSnapshot>(response);
  }

  async dispatch(command: InvestigationCommand): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot> {
    if (command.type === "create") throw new Error("Creation must be requested from the server-owned create endpoint.");
    const id = investigationIdOf(command);
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ command }),
      cache: "no-store",
    });
    return read<InvestigationSnapshot>(response);
  }

  async load(id: InvestigationId): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot | undefined> {
    const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { cache: "no-store" });
    if (response.status === 404) return undefined;
    return read<InvestigationSnapshot>(response);
  }
}

function investigationIdOf(command: Exclude<InvestigationCommand, { type: "create" }>): InvestigationId {
  if (command.type === "source-requested" || command.type === "source-started") return command.identity.investigationId;
  if (command.type === "source-completed") return command.result.identity.investigationId;
  return asInvestigationId(command.investigationId);
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\server\file-investigation-store.ts =====
import { promises as fs } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import type { InvestigationEvent } from "../contracts/investigation-event";
import type { InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { InvestigationEventStore } from "../ports/investigation-event-store";
import type { InvestigationRepository } from "../ports/investigation-repository";

const root = path.resolve(process.env.LATTICE_INVESTIGATION_DATA_DIR?.trim() || path.join(process.cwd(), ".lattice-data", "investigations"));
const safeId = (id: InvestigationId) => String(id).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");
const snapshotPath = (id: InvestigationId) => path.join(root, safeId(id), "snapshot.json");
const eventsPath = (id: InvestigationId) => path.join(root, safeId(id), "events.json");

async function json<T>(file: string, fallback: T): Promise<T> {
  try { return JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(file, "utf8")) as T; }
  catch (error) { if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return fallback; throw error; }
}
async function atomic(file: string, value: unknown): Promise<void> {
  await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  const temporary = `${file}.${process.pid}.${crypto.randomUUID()}.tmp`;
  const handle = await fs.open(temporary, "w");
  try { await handle.writeFile(JSON.stringify(value), "utf8"); await handle.sync(); }
  finally { await handle.close(); }
  try { await retryTransient(() => fs.rename(temporary, file)); }
  finally { await fs.rm(temporary, { force: true }).catch(() => undefined); }
}
async function retryTransient(work: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  const delays = [25, 50, 100, 200, 400, 800, 1200, 1800];
  for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
    try { await work(); return; }
    catch (error) {
      const code = (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code;
      const transient = code === "EPERM" || code === "EBUSY" || code === "EACCES";
      if (!transient || attempt >= delays.length) throw new Error(transient ? "Investigation storage is temporarily locked after bounded retries." : error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Investigation persistence failed.");
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delays[attempt]));
    }
  }
}

export class FileInvestigationRepository implements InvestigationRepository {
  async load<TCanonical = unknown>(id: InvestigationId): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> | undefined> {
    return json<InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> | undefined>(snapshotPath(id), undefined);
  }
  async save<TCanonical = unknown>(snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical>, expectedRevision: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = await this.load(snapshot.identity.investigationId);
    if (current && current.identity.revision !== expectedRevision)
      throw new Error(`Investigation revision conflict: expected ${expectedRevision}, found ${current.identity.revision}.`);
    await atomic(snapshotPath(snapshot.identity.investigationId), snapshot);
  }
}

export class FileInvestigationEventStore implements InvestigationEventStore {
  async append(id: InvestigationId, events: readonly InvestigationEvent[], expectedSequence: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = await this.read(id);
    if (current.length !== expectedSequence)
      throw new Error(`Event sequence conflict: expected ${expectedSequence}, found ${current.length}.`);
    await atomic(eventsPath(id), [...current, ...events]);
  }
  async read(id: InvestigationId): Promise<readonly InvestigationEvent[]> {
    return json<InvestigationEvent[]>(eventsPath(id), []);
  }
}

        completedAt: now,

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\testing\in-memory-event-store.ts =====
import type { InvestigationEvent } from "../contracts/investigation-event";
import type { InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationEventStore } from "../ports/investigation-event-store";

export class InMemoryInvestigationEventStore implements InvestigationEventStore {
  private readonly streams = new Map<InvestigationId, InvestigationEvent[]>();

  async append(id: InvestigationId, events: readonly InvestigationEvent[], expectedSequence: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = this.streams.get(id) ?? [];
    if (current.length !== expectedSequence)
      throw new Error(`Event sequence conflict: expected ${expectedSequence}, found ${current.length}.`);
    this.streams.set(id, [...current, ...events]);
  }

  async read(id: InvestigationId): Promise<readonly InvestigationEvent[]> {
    return [...(this.streams.get(id) ?? [])];
  }
}

import type { InvestigationId } from "../contracts/investigation-identity";
import type { InvestigationSnapshot } from "../contracts/investigation-snapshot";
import type { InvestigationRepository } from "../ports/investigation-repository";

export class InMemoryInvestigationRepository implements InvestigationRepository {
  private readonly values = new Map<InvestigationId, InvestigationSnapshot>();

  async load<TCanonical = unknown>(id: InvestigationId): Promise<InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> | undefined> {
    return this.values.get(id) as InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical> | undefined;
  }

  async save<TCanonical = unknown>(snapshot: InvestigationSnapshot<TCanonical>, expectedRevision: number): Promise<void> {
    const current = this.values.get(snapshot.identity.investigationId);
    if (current && current.identity.revision !== expectedRevision)
      throw new Error(`Investigation revision conflict: expected ${expectedRevision}, found ${current.identity.revision}.`);
    this.values.set(snapshot.identity.investigationId, snapshot as InvestigationSnapshot);
  }
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\layout\bilateral-route-adapter.ts =====
import type { LatticeFlowEdge, LatticeFlowNode } from "../canvas/lattice-flow-types";
import type { LayoutRoute } from "./layout-contract";
import type { BilateralPortPlan, BilateralSide } from "./bilateral-layout-contract";
import { BILATERAL_LAYOUT_CONFIG } from "./bilateral-layout-contract";

export function planBilateralRoutes(nodes: LatticeFlowNode[], edges: LatticeFlowEdge[], positions: Record<string,{x:number;y:number}>, sideByNode: Record<string,BilateralSide>) {
  const byId = new Map(nodes.map((node) => [node.id,node]));
  const routes: Record<string,LayoutRoute> = {};
  const ports: Record<string,BilateralPortPlan> = {};
  for (const edge of edges) {
    const source=byId.get(edge.source), target=byId.get(edge.target);
    if(!source||!target||!positions[source.id]||!positions[target.id]) continue;
    const side=sideByNode[target.id]??sideByNode[source.id]??"RIGHT";
    const sourceSide=side==="LEFT"?"west":"east";
    const targetSide=side==="LEFT"?"east":"west";
    const sp=positions[source.id],tp=positions[target.id];
    const sw=source.width??Number(source.style?.width)??272, sh=source.height??Number(source.style?.height)??96;
    const tw=target.width??Number(target.style?.width)??272, th=target.height??Number(target.style?.height)??96;
    const start={x:sourceSide==="east"?sp.x+sw:sp.x,y:sp.y+sh/2};
    const end={x:targetSide==="west"?tp.x:tp.x+tw,y:tp.y+th/2};
    const departure=BILATERAL_LAYOUT_CONFIG.routeDeparture*(side==="LEFT"?-1:1);
    const laneX=start.x+departure;
    const approachX=end.x-departure;
    routes[edge.id]={edgeId:edge.id,start,bends:[{x:laneX,y:start.y},{x:approachX,y:end.y}],end,label:{x:(laneX+approachX)/2,y:(start.y+end.y)/2},family:String(edge.data?.category??"structure")};
    ports[edge.id]={edgeId:edge.id,sourceSide,targetSide};
  }
  return {routes,ports};
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\layout\bilateral-visible-graph.ts =====
import type { LatticeFlowEdge, LatticeFlowNode } from "../canvas/lattice-flow-types";
import type { BilateralSide } from "./bilateral-layout-contract";

const structural = (edge: LatticeFlowEdge) =>
  edge.data?.relationshipKind === "contains" || edge.data?.relationshipKind === "represented-by";

export function buildBilateralVisibleGraph(nodes: LatticeFlowNode[], edges: LatticeFlowEdge[]) {
  const subject = nodes.find((node) => node.data.category === "subject" || node.data.level === 0);
  if (!subject) return null;
  const byId = new Map(nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node]));
  const children = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const edge of edges.filter(structural)) {
    if (!byId.has(edge.source) || !byId.has(edge.target)) continue;
    children.set(edge.source, [...(children.get(edge.source) ?? []), edge.target]);
  }
  for (const values of children.values()) values.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  const domains = (children.get(subject.id) ?? [])
    .map((id) => byId.get(id))
    .filter((node): node is LatticeFlowNode => Boolean(node));
  return { subject, byId, children, domains };
}

export function inheritBranchSide(rootId: string, side: BilateralSide, children: Map<string, string[]>, sideByNode: Record<string, BilateralSide>, depthByNode: Record<string, number>) {
  const visit = (id: string, depth: number) => {
    sideByNode[id] = side;
    depthByNode[id] = depth;
    for (const child of children.get(id) ?? []) visit(child, depth + 1);
  };
  visit(rootId, 1);
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\layout\branch-decomposition.ts =====
import type { ProjectedEdge, RelationshipProjection } from "../contracts/projection";

const STRUCTURAL = new Set(["contains", "represented-by"]);
export type DecomposedBranch = { id: string; rootId: string; nodeIds: string[]; edges: ProjectedEdge[] };
export type DecomposedGraph = {
  subjectId: string;
  branches: DecomposedBranch[];
  crossBranchEdges: ProjectedEdge[];
  orphanNodeIds: string[];
};
const stable = (a: string, b: string) => a.localeCompare(b);

export function decomposeProjection(projection: RelationshipProjection): DecomposedGraph | null {
  if (!projection.nodes.length) return null;
  const ids = new Set(projection.nodes.map((node) => node.id));
  const structural = projection.edges.filter((edge) => STRUCTURAL.has(edge.kind) && ids.has(edge.source) && ids.has(edge.target));
  const incoming = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const edge of structural) incoming.set(edge.target, (incoming.get(edge.target) ?? 0) + 1);
  const subject = [...projection.nodes].sort((a, b) => {
    const aRank = a.kind === "identity" ? 0 : a.level === 0 ? 1 : 2;
    const bRank = b.kind === "identity" ? 0 : b.level === 0 ? 1 : 2;
    return aRank - bRank || a.level - b.level || (incoming.get(a.id) ?? 0) - (incoming.get(b.id) ?? 0) || stable(a.id, b.id);
  })[0];
  const outgoing = new Map<string, ProjectedEdge[]>();
  for (const edge of structural) outgoing.set(edge.source, [...(outgoing.get(edge.source) ?? []), edge]);
  for (const edges of outgoing.values()) edges.sort((a, b) => stable(a.target, b.target) || stable(a.id, b.id));
  const primary = (outgoing.get(subject.id) ?? []).map((edge) => edge.target);
  const roots = primary.length ? [...new Set(primary)].sort(stable) : projection.nodes.filter((node) => node.id !== subject.id && (incoming.get(node.id) ?? 0) === 0).map((node) => node.id).sort(stable);
  const owner = new Map<string, string>();
  const branches: DecomposedBranch[] = roots.map((rootId) => {
    const nodeIds: string[] = [];
    const queue = [rootId];
    while (queue.length) {
      const id = queue.shift()!;
      if (id === subject.id || owner.has(id)) continue;
      owner.set(id, rootId); nodeIds.push(id);
      for (const edge of outgoing.get(id) ?? []) queue.push(edge.target);
    }
    nodeIds.sort(stable);
    const owned = new Set(nodeIds);
    const edges = structural.filter((edge) => owned.has(edge.source) && owned.has(edge.target)).sort((a, b) => stable(a.id, b.id));
    return { id: rootId, rootId, nodeIds, edges };
  }).filter((branch) => branch.nodeIds.length);
  const crossBranchEdges = projection.edges.filter((edge) => {
    if (edge.source === subject.id || edge.target === subject.id) return !STRUCTURAL.has(edge.kind);
    return owner.get(edge.source) !== owner.get(edge.target) || !STRUCTURAL.has(edge.kind);
  }).sort((a, b) => stable(a.id, b.id));
  const orphanNodeIds = projection.nodes.map((node) => node.id).filter((id) => id !== subject.id && !owner.has(id)).sort(stable);
  return { subjectId: subject.id, branches, crossBranchEdges, orphanNodeIds };
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\layout\elk-branch-builder.ts =====
import type { RelationshipProjection } from "../contracts/projection";
import type { CardinalDirection, PortSide, Size } from "./layout-contract";
import type { DecomposedBranch } from "./branch-decomposition";

export type ElkPortInput = { id: string; width: number; height: number; layoutOptions: Record<string, string> };
export type ElkNodeInput = { id: string; width: number; height: number; ports: ElkPortInput[]; layoutOptions?: Record<string, string> };
export type ElkEdgeInput = { id: string; sources: string[]; targets: string[] };
export type ElkBranchGraph = { id: string; layoutOptions: Record<string, string>; children: ElkNodeInput[]; edges: ElkEdgeInput[] };
const sidePair = (direction: CardinalDirection): [PortSide, PortSide] => direction === "RIGHT" ? ["WEST", "EAST"] : direction === "LEFT" ? ["EAST", "WEST"] : direction === "DOWN" ? ["NORTH", "SOUTH"] : ["SOUTH", "NORTH"];
export const nodeSize = (kind: string): Size => kind === "identity" ? { width: 344, height: 132 } : { width: 272, height: 96 };

export function buildElkBranchGraph(branch: DecomposedBranch, projection: RelationshipProjection, direction: CardinalDirection): ElkBranchGraph {
  const byId = new Map(projection.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node]));
  const [inputSide, outputSide] = sidePair(direction);
  const children = branch.nodeIds.map((id) => {
    const size = nodeSize(byId.get(id)?.kind ?? "component");
    return { id, ...size, ports: [
      { id: `${id}:in`, width: 1, height: 1, layoutOptions: { "elk.port.side": inputSide, "elk.port.index": "0" } },
      { id: `${id}:out`, width: 1, height: 1, layoutOptions: { "elk.port.side": outputSide, "elk.port.index": "1" } },
    ], layoutOptions: { "elk.portConstraints": "FIXED_ORDER" } };
  });
  const edges = branch.edges.map((edge) => ({ id: edge.id, sources: [`${edge.source}:out`], targets: [`${edge.target}:in`] }));
  return { id: `branch:${branch.id}`, children, edges, layoutOptions: {
    "elk.algorithm": "layered", "elk.direction": direction, "elk.edgeRouting": "ORTHOGONAL",
    "elk.layered.layering.strategy": "NETWORK_SIMPLEX", "elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy": "LAYER_SWEEP",
    "elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy": "BRANDES_KOEPF", "elk.layered.considerModelOrder.strategy": "NODES_AND_EDGES",
    "elk.layered.considerModelOrder.portModelOrder": "true", "elk.layered.portSortingStrategy": "INPUT_ORDER",
    "elk.separateConnectedComponents": "false", "elk.spacing.nodeNode": "48",
    "elk.layered.spacing.nodeNodeBetweenLayers": "104", "elk.spacing.edgeNode": "28", "elk.spacing.edgeEdge": "18", "elk.spacing.portPort": "12",
    "elk.padding": "[top=24,left=24,bottom=24,right=24]",
  } };
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\layout\elk-result-adapter.ts =====
import type { Bounds, CardinalDirection, LayoutPort, LayoutRoute, PortSide, Size } from "./layout-contract";
import type { NodePosition } from "../contracts/projection";

type ElkPoint = { x?: number; y?: number };
type ElkPort = ElkPoint & { id: string; width?: number; height?: number; layoutOptions?: Record<string, string>; properties?: Record<string, string> };
type ElkNode = ElkPoint & { id: string; width?: number; height?: number; ports?: ElkPort[] };
type ElkSection = { startPoint?: ElkPoint; bendPoints?: ElkPoint[]; endPoint?: ElkPoint };
type ElkEdge = { id: string; sections?: ElkSection[] };
export type ElkGraphResult = { width?: number; height?: number; children?: ElkNode[]; edges?: ElkEdge[] };
const finite = (value: number | undefined) => Number.isFinite(value) ? value! : 0;
const defaultSide = (direction: CardinalDirection, output: boolean): PortSide => direction === "RIGHT" ? output ? "EAST" : "WEST" : direction === "LEFT" ? output ? "WEST" : "EAST" : direction === "DOWN" ? output ? "SOUTH" : "NORTH" : output ? "NORTH" : "SOUTH";

export function adaptElkResult(result: ElkGraphResult, rootId: string, direction: CardinalDirection) {
  const raw = Object.fromEntries((result.children ?? []).map((node) => [node.id, { x: finite(node.x), y: finite(node.y) }]));
  const root = (result.children ?? []).find((node) => node.id === rootId) ?? result.children?.[0];
  const rootCenter = { x: finite(root?.x) + finite(root?.width) / 2, y: finite(root?.y) + finite(root?.height) / 2 };
  const positions: Record<string, NodePosition> = {};
  const dimensions: Record<string, Size> = {};
  const ports: Record<string, LayoutPort> = {};
  for (const node of result.children ?? []) {
    positions[node.id] = { x: raw[node.id].x - rootCenter.x, y: raw[node.id].y - rootCenter.y };
    dimensions[node.id] = { width: finite(node.width), height: finite(node.height) };
    for (const port of node.ports ?? []) {
      const side = (port.layoutOptions?.["elk.port.side"] ?? port.properties?.["org.eclipse.elk.port.side"] ?? defaultSide(direction, port.id.endsWith(":out"))) as PortSide;
      ports[port.id] = { id: port.id, nodeId: node.id, side, position: { x: positions[node.id].x + finite(port.x), y: positions[node.id].y + finite(port.y) } };
    }
  }
  const routes: Record<string, LayoutRoute> = {};
  for (const edge of result.edges ?? []) {
    const section = edge.sections?.[0];
    if (!section?.startPoint || !section.endPoint) continue;
    routes[edge.id] = { edgeId: edge.id, start: { x: finite(section.startPoint.x) - rootCenter.x, y: finite(section.startPoint.y) - rootCenter.y }, bends: (section.bendPoints ?? []).map((p) => ({ x: finite(p.x) - rootCenter.x, y: finite(p.y) - rootCenter.y })), end: { x: finite(section.endPoint.x) - rootCenter.x, y: finite(section.endPoint.y) - rootCenter.y } };
  }
  const all = Object.entries(positions);
  const bounds: Bounds = all.length ? {
    x: Math.min(...all.map(([id,p]) => p.x)), y: Math.min(...all.map(([id,p]) => p.y)),
    width: Math.max(...all.map(([id,p]) => p.x + dimensions[id].width)) - Math.min(...all.map(([,p]) => p.x)),
    height: Math.max(...all.map(([id,p]) => p.y + dimensions[id].height)) - Math.min(...all.map(([,p]) => p.y)),
  } : { x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 };
  return { positions, dimensions, ports, routes, bounds };
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\layout\incremental-expansion-layout.ts =====
import type { NodePosition, RelationshipProjection } from "../contracts/projection";
import type { Size } from "./layout-contract";

const NODE_GAP = 32;
const GROUP_GAP = 56;

function descendants(projection: RelationshipProjection, rootId: string) {
  const outgoing = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const edge of projection.edges) {
    if (edge.kind !== "contains" && edge.kind !== "represented-by") continue;
    outgoing.set(edge.source, [...(outgoing.get(edge.source) ?? []), edge.target]);
  }
  const found = new Set<string>();
  const queue = [...(outgoing.get(rootId) ?? [])];
  while (queue.length) {
    const id = queue.shift()!;
    if (found.has(id)) continue;
    found.add(id);
    queue.push(...(outgoing.get(id) ?? []));
  }
  return found;
}

export function anchorPinnedSubtrees(
  projection: RelationshipProjection,
  positions: Record<string, NodePosition>,
  dimensions: Record<string, Size>,
  pinned: Readonly<Record<string, NodePosition>>,
) {
  const next = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(positions).map(([id, point]) => [id, { ...point }]));
  const pinnedIds = new Set(Object.keys(pinned));
  for (const [parentId, target] of Object.entries(pinned)) {
    const calculated = next[parentId];
    if (!calculated) continue;
    const dx = target.x - calculated.x;
    const dy = target.y - calculated.y;
    for (const childId of descendants(projection, parentId)) {
      if (!next[childId] || pinnedIds.has(childId)) continue;
      next[childId] = { x: next[childId].x + dx, y: next[childId].y + dy };
    }
    next[parentId] = { ...target };
  }
  return resolveVisibleCollisions(next, dimensions, pinnedIds);
}

function resolveVisibleCollisions(
  positions: Record<string, NodePosition>,
  dimensions: Record<string, Size>,
  pinnedIds: ReadonlySet<string>,
) {
  const next = { ...positions };
  const ids = Object.keys(next).filter((id) => dimensions[id]).sort();
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 10; pass += 1) {
    let moved = false;
    for (let leftIndex = 0; leftIndex < ids.length; leftIndex += 1) {
      for (let rightIndex = leftIndex + 1; rightIndex < ids.length; rightIndex += 1) {
        const leftId = ids[leftIndex], rightId = ids[rightIndex];
        const left = next[leftId], right = next[rightId];
        const leftSize = dimensions[leftId], rightSize = dimensions[rightId];
        const overlapX = Math.min(left.x + leftSize.width + GROUP_GAP, right.x + rightSize.width + GROUP_GAP) - Math.max(left.x, right.x);
        const overlapY = Math.min(left.y + leftSize.height + NODE_GAP, right.y + rightSize.height + NODE_GAP) - Math.max(left.y, right.y);
        if (overlapX <= 0 || overlapY <= 0) continue;
        const movableId = pinnedIds.has(rightId) && !pinnedIds.has(leftId) ? leftId : rightId;
        if (pinnedIds.has(movableId)) continue;
        const current = next[movableId];
        next[movableId] = { ...current, y: current.y + overlapY + NODE_GAP };
        moved = true;
      }
    }
    if (!moved) break;
  }
  return next;
}

import type { Bounds, LayoutRoute, Size } from "./layout-contract";
import type { NodePosition } from "../contracts/projection";
import { boundsOverlap } from "./sector-orchestrator";

export const nodeBounds = (id: string, positions: Record<string, NodePosition>, dimensions: Record<string, Size>): Bounds | null => {
  const position = positions[id], size = dimensions[id];
  return position && size ? { ...position, ...size } : null;
};
export function countNodeOverlaps(positions: Record<string, NodePosition>, dimensions: Record<string, Size>, gap = 0) {
  const bounds = Object.keys(positions).map((id) => nodeBounds(id, positions, dimensions)).filter((value): value is Bounds => Boolean(value));
  let count = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < bounds.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < bounds.length; j++) if (boundsOverlap(bounds[i], bounds[j], gap)) count++;
  return count;
}
export function countBranchOverlaps(bounds: readonly Bounds[]) {
  let count = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < bounds.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < bounds.length; j++) if (boundsOverlap(bounds[i], bounds[j], 0)) count++;
  return count;
}
export function countInvalidRoutes(routes: Record<string, LayoutRoute>) {
  return Object.values(routes).filter((route) => [route.start, ...route.bends, route.end].some((point) => !Number.isFinite(point.x) || !Number.isFinite(point.y))).length;
}
export function subjectIntrusions(subject: Bounds, branchBounds: readonly Bounds[], gap = 80) {
  return branchBounds.filter((bounds) => boundsOverlap(subject, bounds, gap)).length;
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\layout\radial-connection-geometry.ts =====
import type { NodePosition } from "../contracts/projection";
import type { PortSide, Size } from "./layout-contract";

const EPSILON = 1e-9;
const MIN_OFFSET_PERCENT = 8;
const MAX_OFFSET_PERCENT = 92;

export type RadialAttachment = {
  id: string;
  branchId: string;
  side: PortSide;
  offsetPercent: number;
  position: NodePosition;
};

export type RadialConnectionGeometry = {
  branchId: string;
  angle: number;
  source: RadialAttachment;
  target: RadialAttachment;
};

const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number) =>
  Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

export function normalizeDirection(dx: number, dy: number): NodePosition {
  const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  if (!Number.isFinite(length) || length <= EPSILON) return { x: 1, y: 0 };
  return { x: dx / length, y: dy / length };
}

export function rectangleBoundaryAttachment({
  id,
  branchId,
  center,
  size,
  direction,
}: {
  id: string;
  branchId: string;
  center: NodePosition;
  size: Size;
  direction: NodePosition;
}): RadialAttachment {
  const unit = normalizeDirection(direction.x, direction.y);
  const halfWidth = Math.max(EPSILON, size.width / 2);
  const halfHeight = Math.max(EPSILON, size.height / 2);
  const scaleX = Math.abs(unit.x) > EPSILON ? halfWidth / Math.abs(unit.x) : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  const scaleY = Math.abs(unit.y) > EPSILON ? halfHeight / Math.abs(unit.y) : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  const scale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);
  const position = { x: center.x + unit.x * scale, y: center.y + unit.y * scale };

  const horizontal = Math.abs(unit.x) >= Math.abs(unit.y);
  const side: PortSide = horizontal
    ? unit.x >= 0 ? "EAST" : "WEST"
    : unit.y >= 0 ? "SOUTH" : "NORTH";
  const rawOffset = side === "NORTH" || side === "SOUTH"
    ? ((position.x - (center.x - halfWidth)) / (halfWidth * 2)) * 100
    : ((position.y - (center.y - halfHeight)) / (halfHeight * 2)) * 100;

  return {
    id,
    branchId,
    side,
    offsetPercent: clamp(rawOffset, MIN_OFFSET_PERCENT, MAX_OFFSET_PERCENT),
    position,
  };
}

export function radialConnectionGeometry({
  branchId,
  angle,
  sourceCenter,
  sourceSize,
  targetCenter,
  targetSize,
}: {
  branchId: string;
  angle: number;
  sourceCenter: NodePosition;
  sourceSize: Size;
  targetCenter: NodePosition;
  targetSize: Size;
}): RadialConnectionGeometry {
  const direction = normalizeDirection(Math.cos(angle), Math.sin(angle));
  return {
    branchId,
    angle,
    source: rectangleBoundaryAttachment({
      id: `radial-source:${branchId}`,
      branchId,
      center: sourceCenter,
      size: sourceSize,
      direction,
    }),
    target: rectangleBoundaryAttachment({
      id: `radial-target:${branchId}`,
      branchId,
      center: targetCenter,
      size: targetSize,
      direction: { x: -direction.x, y: -direction.y },
    }),
  };
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\layout\radial-route-adapter.ts =====
import type { LayoutRoute, RadialLayoutConnection } from "./layout-contract";

export function applyRadialFirstHopRoutes(
  routes: Readonly<Record<string, LayoutRoute>>,
  connections: Readonly<Record<string, RadialLayoutConnection>>,
): Record<string, LayoutRoute> {
  const next = { ...routes };
  for (const [edgeId, connection] of Object.entries(connections).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))) {
    const existing = routes[edgeId];
    const start = { ...connection.source.position };
    const end = { ...connection.target.position };
    next[edgeId] = {
      edgeId,
      start,
      bends: [],
      end,
      family: existing?.family ?? "structure",
      lane: existing?.lane,
      label: { x: (start.x + end.x) / 2, y: (start.y + end.y) / 2 },
      fallback: false,
    };
  }
  return next;
}

import type { NodePosition, ProjectedEdge, RelationshipProjection } from "../contracts/projection";
import type { Bounds, LayoutBranch, LayoutRoute, Size } from "./layout-contract";

export type RouteFamily = "structure"|"correspondence"|"requirement"|"change-impact"|"operational-impact"|"configuration"|"evidence";
export type RoutingDiagnostics={routedEdgeCount:number;fallbackEdgeCount:number;invalidRouteCount:number;routeNodeIntersectionCount:number;routeBranchIntersectionCount:number;overlappingSegmentCount:number;labelCollisionCount:number;averageBendCount:number;routingDurationMs:number};
const structural=new Set(["contains","represented-by"]);
const family=(kind:string):RouteFamily=>kind==="contains"||kind==="represented-by"?"structure":kind==="corresponds-to"||kind==="comparison"?"correspondence":kind==="requirement"?"requirement":kind==="business-impact"?"operational-impact":"evidence";

const segmentLength=(a:NodePosition,b:NodePosition)=>Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);
const segmentMid=(a:NodePosition,b:NodePosition):NodePosition=>({x:(a.x+b.x)/2,y:(a.y+b.y)/2});
const routeKey=(e:ProjectedEdge)=>[e.source,e.target].sort().join("|");
function preferredLabel(points:NodePosition[],occupied:NodePosition[]){let best=segmentMid(points[0],points.at(-1)!);let length=-1;for(let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++){const candidate=segmentMid(points[i],points[i+1]);const score=segmentLength(points[i],points[i+1]);if(score>length&&occupied.every(p=>Math.hypot(p.x-candidate.x,p.y-candidate.y)>72)){best=candidate;length=score}}occupied.push(best);return best}
function corridorRoute(edge:ProjectedEdge,start:NodePosition,end:NodePosition,lane:number,bounds:Bounds[],subjectId:string){
 const f=family(edge.kind); if(edge.source===subjectId||edge.target===subjectId){const offset=46+lane*18;const sx=start.x<end.x?1:-1;return [start,{x:start.x+sx*offset,y:start.y},{x:end.x-sx*offset,y:end.y},end]}
 const vertical=Math.abs(end.y-start.y)>Math.abs(end.x-start.x);const margin=90+lane*22;
 if(vertical){const candidates=[Math.min(...bounds.map(b=>b.x))-margin,Math.max(...bounds.map(b=>b.x+b.width))+margin];const x=candidates.sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a-start.x)+Math.abs(a-end.x)-Math.abs(b-start.x)-Math.abs(b-end.x))[0];return [start,{x,y:start.y},{x,y:end.y},end]}

}
export function routeRelationships(projection:RelationshipProjection,positions:Record<string,NodePosition>,dimensions:Record<string,Size>,branches:LayoutBranch[],elkRoutes:Record<string,LayoutRoute>,pinned:Readonly<Record<string,NodePosition>>={}){
 const began=Date.now(), routes:Record<string,LayoutRoute>={},labels:Record<string,NodePosition>={}, occupied:NodePosition[]=[];const groups=new Map<string,ProjectedEdge[]>();for(const e of projection.edges)groups.set(routeKey(e),[...(groups.get(routeKey(e))??[]),e]);for(const g of groups.values())g.sort((a,b)=>a.kind.localeCompare(b.kind)||a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
